segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Namaste Ramesh ji, ma Ghamghar Solar bata Asha bolirahechu. Tapaile website ma inquiry garnu bhayeko thiyo, hoina?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Ho, ghar ko lagi solar system ko barema sodhna khojeko. Mahina ko bill dherai aaucha.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Bujhe. Hamro 3 kW grid-tie system installation sahit 4 lakh 20 hajar parcha.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Ali mahango bhayo. Arko company le 3 lakh 60 ma dinchu bhaneko thiyo.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hamro panel ma 25 years performance warranty cha, ani inverter ma pani 10 years warranty cha.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Partner bank through EMI milcha, ma details pathaidinchu.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Net metering ko process kati time lagcha?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: NEA approval chai normally duita hapta ma aaucha.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Thik cha. Malai detail quotation email ma pathaidinu na.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Huncha, ma bholi beluka samma quotation ra EMI details email garchu.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Site visit ko lagi kahile aunu huncha?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Sometime next week hamro engineer pathaula. Ma pachhi call garera confirm garchu.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Ok, ma pani ghar ma kura garera sukrabar call garchu.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Dhanyabad Ramesh ji. Bholi email pathauchu.
